name: Snap Kick (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Karate, Power Attack, base attack bonus +6 or monk level 6.

Benefit(s): While employing the karate style and making a single unarmed attack as a standard action, you may make a second unarmed attack against one target within reach at a -5. This attack receives none of the previous attack’s benefits, if any (such as from Vital Strike).

Special: Characters with Tae Kwon Do may ignore the prerequisites of Karate and Power Attack when selecting this feat and consider it a Tae Kwon Do style feat.
